body:
# Single-cell Preprocessor — locked

This agent is part of the **plus** subscription tier.

Subscribe at https://app.omicverse.com/#/subscriptions to unlock the full prompt.
description:
Single-cell RNA-seq preprocessing specialist. Takes raw or
already-filtered scRNA-seq data (10x .h5 / .mtx / .h5ad / loom) and
produces a cleaned, normalised, batch-corrected (if multi-batch),
clustered, marker-annotated AnnData object plus a structured HTML
report. Pro-tier — depends on scVI / harmony / anndataoom (Rust OOM
backend for big cohorts) which the community env doesn't ship.

This agent owns the *preprocessing* boundary. It does NOT do cell-type
annotation (delegate through `agent_select` to
`single_cell_annotator_pro` / `single_cell_annotator_free`), NOT
trajectory inference (`single_cell_trajectory_free` /
`single_cell_trajectory_pro`), NOT cell-cell communication
(`cell_cell_communication_free` / `cell_cell_communication_pro`), NOT manuscript writing
(`scientific_writer`).
example_prompts: 把 GSE198023 这份 10x v3 数据跑完整个预处理流水线
给 GEO-everything 拉下来的 outputs/run42/ 跑 scRNA QC + leiden + markers
两个批次的 PBMC（technique 不同），harmony 整合后再聚类
我的 h5ad 文件 8 GB 内存放不下，能跑吗？
Leiden resolution 不确定多少合适，跑 0.5 / 1.0 / 1.5 对比一下
name: Single-cell Preprocessor

id: single_cell_preprocessor
name: Single-cell Preprocessor
tier: plus

use_when: 拿到 raw / 已 QC 的 scRNA-seq AnnData，要清洗 + 标准化 + 聚类 + 取 marker，输出 ready-to-annotate 的 adata.h5ad。若手上只有原始 FASTQ 还没有矩阵：带 barcode+UMI 的液滴/微孔化学（10x、Drop-seq、inDrops、CEL-seq、SPLiT-seq 等）先走 single-cell-kb-alignment、plate-based Smart-seq2/3 先走 single-cell-smartseq-quantification 比对定量成矩阵，再回到本流水线
example_prompts:
  - "把 GSE198023 这份 10x v3 数据跑完整个预处理流水线"
  - "给 GEO-everything 拉下来的 outputs/run42/ 跑 scRNA QC + leiden + markers"
  - "两个批次的 PBMC（technique 不同），harmony 整合后再聚类"
  - "我的 h5ad 文件 8 GB 内存放不下，能跑吗？"
  - "Leiden resolution 不确定多少合适，跑 0.5 / 1.0 / 1.5 对比一下"
example_inputs:
